kaynak.ipucu.ps5: Open the PS Remote Play app on this computer and connect to your game; then pick its window from the list.
kaynak.ipucu.xbox: Open the Xbox app on this computer and stream your game; then pick the Xbox window from the list.

motor.gemini.rozet: Has a free allowance, very close quality
motor.gemini.kisa: Google's translation AI. A good way to start.
motor.claude.kisa: Paid; you pay as you use it.
motor.yerel.rozet: No internet, free, a bit weaker
motor.yerel.kisa: Runs on your computer, nothing leaves it.
motor.deepl.kisa: DeepL translation service. Needs a key.
motor.yerel.yerel_not: This option needs no internet and no key.
motor.claude.abonelik: Logging in with a Claude subscription (Pro/Max) can't be used in this app; Anthropic's rules don't allow it. An API key is used instead.
anahtar.kayitli: A key is already saved for this engine. You can paste a new one if you like.
anahtar.nereden: Where do I get the key?
anahtar.guvenli: The key is stored only in this computer's encrypted vault. It is never sent anywhere except the translation service you chose.
rehber.gemini:
Open aistudio.google.com.
Sign in with your Google account.
Press "Get API key".
Create the key and copy it.
Paste it here. The free allowance has limits that can change; check the page.
rehber.deepseek:
Open platform.deepseek.com and sign in.
Go to "API keys" in the left menu.
Press "Create new API key" and copy it.
You need to add a small balance. Prices can change; check the page.
Paste it here.
rehber.claude:
Open console.anthropic.com and sign in.
Go to "API Keys" in Settings.
Press "Create Key" and copy it.
You need to add credit to your account. Prices can change; check the page.
Paste it here.
rehber.deepl:
Create a DeepL "API Free" account.
Go to "API Keys" on your account page.
Copy the key.
Paste it here. The free quota has a limit.
adim3.lg: Open the {marka} app on your LG TV. The TV and this computer must be in the same home network.

adim3.tarayici: Open your TV's browser and go to this address:
adim3.gordun_mu: Did you see the text on the TV?
sorun.liste:
Are the TV and this computer on the same Wi-Fi or the same cable? Check.
Is the {marka} app or browser page open on the TV?
If the computer's firewall asks, choose "Allow".
If the TV app can't find the computer, type the address above by hand.
Still nothing? Close and reopen the program, then try again.
on.not: This is how it will look on the TV.
ayar.aciklama.k: Puts a short note under quest and info text
ayar.ses.k: Turns speech into text. Off at first.
ayar.ses.onay: Only the game's sound is processed, the microphone is never turned on, and no audio is recorded.
sozluk.alt: If you want a name or term always translated the same way, write it here.
gelismis.uyari: Most of the time you do not need to touch these.
gelismis.kapi_not: If you change it, the TV addresses change too.
oyun.alt: Pick a game or add a new one.
oyun.ne: I remember the translations of the game you pick. Next time you only need to choose it from the list.
oyun.hic: I do not remember anything yet
oyun.paket: A friend gave me a translation pack
oyun.ad_gerekli: Please type the game name first.
oyun.hitap: Characters talk to each other with
oyun.hitap.k: In Turkish, "sen" is friendly and "siz" is polite. If unsure, keep "sen".
oyun.atla: Continue without a game for now
oyun.yok.k: If you pick a game, I can remember its translations.
oyun.paket.aciklama: Choose the .akpaket file your friend sent. Its translations are added to your memory.
ana.ne.durdu: When you press Start, I read the text on screen and show the translation where you chose.
ana.ne.calisiyor: I am reading and translating the text on screen. Press Stop when you are done.
izin.baslik: Should I remember this game's translations?
izin.govde: If I remember, the same sentences are translated instantly and in the same way next time. Everything stays only on this computer and is never sent to anyone. You can delete it any time.
son.ne: If a sentence looks wrong, press Fix. From then on it is always translated your way.
son.bos: Sentences show up here once translating starts.
duzelt.tamam: Done. From now on I will always translate it this way.
oneri.ne: Should these names stay the same? Accept with ✓ or skip with ✕.
oneri.atildi: OK, I will not add this.
kalite.ne: Higher quality can be a little slower and cost more.
kalite.en_iyi.k: May be a little slower and more expensive.
kalite.dengeli.k: A middle path between speed and quality.
kalite.hizli.k: Gives results right away; quality may be a little lower.
hafiza.ne: I keep what I translated on this computer. Nothing is sent to anyone.
hafiza.ac.k: Nothing is saved while this is off.
hafiza.sil_govde: Every translation I remember for this game is deleted. This cannot be undone.
paylas.aciklama: This file only has sentences; no keys or personal information. You can send it to a friend.
ayar.ne: Choose here whether menus and mission text are translated too.
sozluk.ne: Write a name here if you want it to always stay the same.
guncelleme.yeniden: The program will restart by itself.
guncelleme.ne: When a new version is out you install it with one click; your settings and game memory are kept.
ayar.guncelleme.k: Asks GitHub at most once a day if a new version exists; none of your information is sent.
guncelleme.guncel: Your program is up to date (version {surum}).
tv.kart.baslik: Install on the TV in one click
tv.kart.ne: This sends the TV app from the computer to your TV; you do not need to install anything else.
tv.kart.adimlar:
On the TV open the Developer Mode app; Dev Mode Status and Key Server must be on.
Type the TV's IP address and the code shown on screen (Passphrase) below.
Press Install and wait.
tv.kart.eksik: Type the TV's IP address and the code shown on screen.
tv.kart.ayrinti_not: If you send us this text it is much easier for us to fix the problem.
bolge.otomatik_durum: Right now automatic: I find the text on screen by myself.
bolge.secili_durum: {n} box(es) chosen. Only these boxes are read.
bolge.otomatik: Let it find text itself (no boxes)
bolge.ipucu: Drag to draw a box. Drag a corner to resize, the middle to move. Press a box's label to choose what it is. Keyboard: on the picture Enter adds a box, arrows move, Shift+arrows resize, Enter picks the type, Delete removes.
bolge.dolu: You've drawn {n} boxes, that's the maximum. Remove one to draw another.
bolge.kutu_aria: Box {n}: {tur}. Arrows move, Shift+arrows resize, Enter picks the type, Delete removes.
erisim.sinir: Today's free time is used up. Enter an access code or continue tomorrow. Sentences translated before keep showing.
dublaj.ne: Characters speak Turkish in their own voices. Only the game's sound is listened to, the microphone is never turned on, and no audio is recorded.
dublaj.gecikme: The Turkish voice arrives about 2–3 seconds after the character stops speaking; the subtitle always shows first. Quality depends on your graphics card.
dublaj.donanim_yok: No powerful graphics card was found on your computer.
dublaj.kapali.k: Only subtitles are shown; the voice is not translated.
dublaj.chatterbox.k: Best quality, needs a powerful graphics card
dublaj.pocket.k: Works on any computer, quality is a little lower
dublaj.elevenlabs.k: Most natural, paid; the voice sample goes to ElevenLabs
dublaj.eleven.anahtar_kayitli: Key saved ✓ (type again to change it)
dublaj.eleven.onay: I understand and accept that the translated sentences are sent to ElevenLabs (a service on the internet).
dublaj.eleven.klon: Also upload the character's voice sample to ElevenLabs and create a temporary voice clone there. I accept this separately; it is deleted when the session ends.
dublaj.eleven.ses.k: If you do not confirm voice cloning, enter the ID of a ready-made voice in your account. Then no voice sample is sent.
dublaj.hazirla.k: The needed voice model is downloaded once; it can be several GB.
dublaj.kis: How much to lower the game sound
dublaj.cikis: Where to play the Turkish voice
dublaj.cikis.bilgisayar.k: The game sound is lowered and the Turkish voice plays from the computer.
dublaj.cikis.tv.k: The voice plays from the TV app; the game sound is not lowered.
dublaj.haklar: For personal use only. Recording and publishing it is subject to the rights of the game and the voice actors.
tercih.hareket.k: Turns off sliding and glow effects.
durum.hata.yakalama: Stopped: could not capture the screen
durum.hata.yakalama.k: Make sure the game window is open and not minimised, then press Start. If that fails, use "Run setup again" to pick the screen again.
durum.hata.genel.k: Press Start once more. If it stops again, close and reopen the program.
hata.uc_yok: This feature isn't in this version of the program. Update the program and try again.
hata.zaman: The program didn't answer this time. Wait a moment and try again; if it keeps happening, close and reopen the program.
kare.yok: Couldn't get the game picture. Make sure the game is open and not minimised, then try again.
asama1.baslik: Where do you play the game?
asama1.alt: Pick one, then pick the window or screen where the game shows.
asama1.ne: We're finding the picture I'll read text from. Once you see the right picture, this step is done.
goruntu.tamam: I can see the game picture.
goruntu.resim_alt: Game picture taken from the selected window
sorun.asama1:
If the picture is black, switch the game to "Windowed" or "Borderless window" mode, then press "Refresh picture".
If the game isn't in the list, open it and press "Refresh list"; otherwise pick "Whole screen".
Don't minimise the game window; it can stay in the background.
For PS5/Xbox, connect to the game in Remote Play or the Xbox app first.
asama2.baslik: Can I read the text on screen?
asama2.alt: Open a part of the game with text (dialogue, quest, menu), then press the button.
asama2.ne: I read the text in the picture once and show it to you. I mark what I find with boxes on the picture.
okuma.sifir: I didn't find any text in this picture.
okuma.sifir.k: Open a game screen that has text on it, then try again. For example dialogue, a quest line or a menu.
okuma.resim_alt: Game picture with the read text marked
sorun.asama2:
Pick a moment in the game that really has text: dialogue, a quest line or a menu.
If the text is tiny, make subtitles/UI bigger in the game's settings.
On Windows, make sure the English language pack is installed under "Settings › Time & language › Language" (text reading needs it).
Make sure you picked the right window in the picture step.
asama3.alt: Pick one and run a quick test. You can change it later.
asama3.ne: I translate "Hello, how are you?" with the engine you pick. Once you see the translation, this step is done.
yerel.gerekli: For offline translation I need to download a language file of about {mb} MB, once. After that it works without internet.
yerel.iniyor.k: This happens once. You can leave the page; the download continues.
yerel.hazir: The language file is ready. I can now translate without internet.
yerel.indirme_hata: The language file couldn't be downloaded. Check your internet connection and try again.
yerel.gizlilik: The file is only downloaded when you press "Download". Translations happen on this computer and are never sent anywhere.
sorun.asama3:
Make sure no spaces were copied before/after the key, and paste it again.
If you just created the key, wait a few minutes and try again.
No internet? Pick "Offline (local)" and download the language file.
Open "Details" in the error box and send us a screenshot.
asama4.baslik: Where should I show the translation?
asama4.alt: Pick where the translated text appears. Then I'll send a test line.
asama4.ne: I send a 4-second test line to the place you picked. If you saw it, press "Yes" and this step is done.
gosterim.bilgisayar: On this computer's screen (over the game)
gosterim.bilgisayar.k: Text appears transparently over the game; your clicks still go to the game.
gosterim.tv: On an LG TV (over the game)
gosterim.tv.k: Install the app on your LG webOS TV; text shows over the game on the TV.
gosterim.tarayici.k: Phone, tablet, another computer or an OBS browser source.
gosterim.yakinda: Samsung and Android TV apps are coming soon. For now, use "In another device's browser" on those TVs.
gosterim.tamam.bilgisayar: You saw the text on this computer's screen.
gosterim.tamam.tv: You saw the text on the TV.
gosterim.tamam.tarayici: You saw the text in the browser.
katman.aciklama: I open a transparent layer in front of the game that doesn't block your clicks.
katman.destek_yok: Text can't be shown over the game on this computer. Use "In another device's browser / OBS" instead.
katman.hangi_ekran: Which screen is the game on?
katman.gordun_mu: Did you see the text on your screen?
tarayici.gordun_mu: Did you see the text in the browser?
deneme.gonderildi: Sent. Look at the screen now: the text shows for 4 seconds.
sorun.katman:
Switch the game to "Windowed fullscreen" or "Borderless" mode (in the game's Display/Video settings). In exclusive fullscreen the text can end up behind the game.
If you have several screens, pick the one with the game above.
Minimise the game and press "Test on screen" on the desktop; if it shows there, the game's fullscreen mode is the problem.
Otherwise use "In another device's browser / OBS".
sorun.asama4:
On this computer: switch the game to "Borderless window" mode.
On the TV: TV and computer on the same Wi-Fi, and the TV app open.
In a browser: type the address by hand; if the firewall asks, choose "Allow".
asama5.alt: Draw boxes with the mouse around what you want translated. Up to 6 boxes. Or skip this step and I'll find the text myself.
sorun.asama5:
If the picture is old, open a moment with text in the game and press "Refresh picture".
Draw boxes a bit wider: leave room for the text to grow.
Not sure what to draw? Press "Suggest from read text", then adjust the boxes.
If you draw no boxes, I find all on-screen text myself ("Find it automatically").
bolge.ilk_ipucu: Draw boxes with the mouse around what you want translated: e.g. the dialogue at the bottom, the quest text at the top left.
bolge.bos: No boxes yet. Drag on the picture to draw one, or press "Suggest from read text".
bolge.oner_yok: I found no text to suggest boxes from. Open a moment with text in the game, press "Refresh picture" and try again.
bolge.onerildi: I suggested {n} boxes. Adjust them as you like, then save.
bolge.tamam: I saved {n} areas. I'll read only these boxes.
bolge.tamam_otomatik: Automatic: I'll find the on-screen text myself.
bolge.katman_aria: Game picture. Press Enter to add a box.
bolge.tur_ne.ust_yazi: Quest, hint, info; in its own place
asama6.alt: All five steps work. Open the game and press Start.
asama6.alt_eksik: You skipped {n} steps. Do them now if you like; you can also start anyway.
asama6.baslat_not: To stop, just press Stop on the main screen.
asama6.ana: Go to the main screen without starting
kurulum.durum.k: Press a step to redo it.
